name: Deep Sea Predator: Commander of the Deep

system.description: You learn a modified version of the Summoning Technique Ninjutsu, with a contract with the Shark tribe. The Shark tribe you are contracted with are a bit more versatile than other shark tribes. When you summon these sharks, they are summoned in a large bubble of Water that they use for land travel, using half their swimming speed to traverse the land.
